a download changed upstream: the CI runner ran out of disk

hash mismatch: action timed out after|timeout reached; test terminating|TimeoutError|building of .* timed out after
a download changed upstream: a VM test hit its time limit
run `nix flake update`: rerun the job; if it fails again, a service hangs at boot

a download changed upstream: the system started but a test found it behaving wrong
run `nix flake update`: read the failing line, then reproduce with `nix build -L .#checks.<system>.<check>`

hash mismatch: ^error: (undefined variable|attribute .* missing|syntax error|The option|infinite recursion|assertion .* failed|cannot coerce)
run `nix flake update`: fix the Nix file and line named in the message

a download changed upstream: a package or test failed to build
run `nix flake update`: read the lines above `Cannot build` in the full log
